title: Murrain
html_source:
A murrain is a plague, disease, or pestilence.

Etymology (wiktionary):
From Anglo-Norman mourine, moreyn, Middle French morine, from Medieval Latin morticinium, ultimately from a form of Latin mori (“to die”).
